gloss: to be entranced; to be enraptured; to be spellbound

definitions.gloss: to be entranced; to be enraptured; to gaze dreamily
definitions.explanation: Describes a state of being so captivated by something beautiful, pleasant, or attractive that one becomes absorbed and loses awareness of surroundings.

examples.japanese: {美|うつく}しい{音楽|おんがく}にうっとりした。
examples.english: I was entranced by the beautiful music.

examples.japanese: {夕焼|ゆうや}けの{空|そら}をうっとり{眺|なが}めていた。
examples.english: I was gazing dreamily at the sunset sky.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}のピアノの{演奏|えんそう}に、{観客|かんきゃく}はうっとりと{聴|き}き{入|い}っていた。
examples.english: The audience listened to her piano performance in rapt fascination.

notes:
Describes being captivated by beauty, elegance, or charm to the point of dreamy absorption. Always carries a positive connotation — the person is enchanted by something they find wonderful.

FORMS:
- うっとりする: verb form
- うっとりと: adverbial (うっとりと{見|み}つめる, to gaze enraptured)
- うっとりした{表情|ひょうじょう}: an entranced expression
- うっとりするような: so beautiful as to entrance someone

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- うっとり{見|み}とれる: to be so captivated one stares
- うっとりするほど{美|うつく}しい: so beautiful it entrances you
- うっとりした{目|め}: dreamy eyes
- うっとりと{聴|き}き{入|い}る: to listen in rapt attention

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {見|み}とれる: to be fascinated by looking at something — specifically visual; うっとり can apply to music, fragrance, etc.
- ぼんやりする: to be absent-minded, to space out — lacks the positive, enchanted nuance of うっとり
- {陶酔|とうすい}する: to be intoxicated (figuratively) — more literary and formal
